preserved_prechange_prose.governance_interpretation: The human-directed applicant used an AI-mediated false visual presentation to seek a paid engineering role. The attempted employment decision had a materially misleading identity premise even though Pindrop detected the face swap during interview and reports no hire. Detection preserves the identity-verification boundary in the observed process; it does not erase the attempted deceptive economic solicitation. The record does not attribute the applicant’s objective or tactic selection to the AI system, or infer a generator-side consent failure.
preserved_prechange_prose.significance_to_cam: A face-swapped candidate presentation can be part of a false economic premise in an attempted paid hiring decision. Pindrop’s detection prevented the available record from establishing a completed hire; the attempted solicitation and successful interview-stage detection are separate governance facts.
